card.name: Punctuation inside technical syntax
card.fires_on: Single symbols or short pieces in command lines, paths, URLs and code, where a name or argument comes next (a dash before a parameter, a flag letter, a colon, a path ending).

modes.label: Flags and dashes
modes.description: A dash or single-letter flag in a command, followed by an argument.

modes.label: Path and URL pieces
modes.description: The end of a path part or the :// in an address.

modes.label: Colon before an item
modes.description: A colon in a syntax pattern or loop, followed by a name.

card.writes: It promotes code-like continuations such as message, element and expression, and suppresses ordinary short word starts.
card.plain: It marks spots in commands, paths and code where a technical name or argument should follow.
